about_the_game:
"2D Dogfight - World War II (Aircrafts of Western Front)" DLC includes the following 35 Aircrafts:

A-20G Havoc
B-17G Flying Fortress
P-40E-1 Kittyhawk
P-38G-1 Lightning
P-47D-22 Thunderbolt
P-51B-7NA Mustang
P-51D-15NA Mustang

Bf-109E-3
Bf-109F-1
Bf-109G-2
Bf-109G-14
Bf-109K-4
Bf-110C-2
Fw-190A-5
Fw-190G-3
Fw-190D-9
Ju-87B-2
Ju-87D-5
Ju-88A-4
Ta-152H-0
Me-262A-1a

Hurrican Mk.I
Lancaster B Mk.I
Spitfire Mk.Ia
Spitfire Mk.Ib
Spitfire Mk.Vb
Spitfire LF Mk.IX
Spitfire F Mk.XIVc
Spitfire F Mk.21
Typhoon Mk.Ib
Tempest V
Meteor F.3
Mosquito B Mk.IX
Mosquito FB Mk.VI
Mosquito NF Mk.XV

Players who purchase this DLC can use these aircrafts in custom game and online game.

8 new missions in the Campaign mode (4 for Allies and 4 for Axis).

In addition, players who purchase the DLC can also get the exclusive menu wallpaper and green theme UI of "World War II (Aircrafts of Western Front)"
